title: High-efficiency transfection of small RNAs and plasmid DNA in human cells
protocol: Plate cells at approximately 25% confluency in 24-well plates using standard growth medium.
Check cell confluency (it should be approximately 50%) and replace the medium with 500 μl of growth medium without antibiotics.
Mix 600 ng of siRNA in 50 μl of Opti-MEM.
Mix 1 μl of RNAiMAX in 50 μl of Opti-MEM.
Combine the two solutions, mix gently, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add the solution uniformly to the cells.
After 4-6 hours, replace the medium with standard growth medium.
Incubate cells for 48 hours under standard conditions.
Replace the medium with 500 μl of growth medium without antibiotics.
Mix 600 ng of miRNA, 80 ng of reporter plasmid, and 40 ng of pCS2-lacZ plasmid in 50 μl of Opti-MEM.
Mix 1 μl of Lipofectamine2000 in 50 μl of Opti-MEM.
Combine the two solutions, mix gently, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
After 4-6 hours, replace the medium with standard growth medium.
Replace the medium with 500 μl of growth medium containing 0.1% serum and incubate for 8 hours.
Dilute the protein ligand in 0.1% serum medium and add the solution to the cells.
Incubate cells under standard conditions for 2-16 hours (according to the ligand activity).
Replace the medium with 200 μl per well of luciferase lysis buffer.
